description: Get the dilution pressure score: a 0-100 score with its seven-component breakdown (shelf capacity, ATM/equity-line capacity, warrants in the money, convertible proximity, cash burn urgency, historical dilution, toxic financing), plus four risk levels — overall, offering ability, overhead supply, cash need. When the filings state no current share count, components that need the share count or market cap (warrants in the money, shelf / ATM capacity) are scored on the best-estimate share count — `details.sharesOutstandingEstimate` {shares, kind, asOf, source} and `details.marketCapSource: "derived_price_x_estimated_os"` say so; report those components as resting on an estimate. 🔴 THE SCORE IS MEANINGLESS WITHOUT `scoreMaxMeasured` AND `scoreWithheldReason`: components whose inputs could not be measured are DROPPED FROM THE DENOMINATOR, so a score of 58 may be 58 out of 85, not out of 100. Always report it as `score`/`scoreMaxMeasured` and name the excluded components from `scoreUnmeasuredComponents`; NEVER rescale it to /100, and never treat a low numerator as a low-risk finding. When `scoreDenominatorThin` is true the score rests on fewer than 70 measured points — report it as a PARTIAL reading ("N of M measured"), never as a full one. A non-null `scoreWithheldReason` (e.g. `no_dilution_snapshot`) means there is NO score — not a score of zero. 🔴 WHEN `levelsAreLowerBound` IS TRUE THE LEVELS ARE FLOORS, NOT MEASUREMENTS: a "medium" then means AT LEAST medium. State it as a lower bound; presenting a floor as a measurement understates the risk of a named issuer. `levelsLowerBoundScope` names WHICH levels are floors and ONLY those carry the at-least qualifier; `levelsLowerBoundReason` says why: `unquantified_live_instruments` (instruments that could not be sized were excluded — floors `overall` + `overheadSupply`), `offering_capacity_unknown` (a live shelf/ATM/equity line/registration states no remaining capacity) or `market_cap_unmeasured` (no market cap to compare capacity against) — both of which floor `overall` + `offeringAbility`, NOT `overheadSupply`; `os_growth_span_short` (share counts span under a year, growth shown raw, not annualized — floors `historical` + `overall`) or `os_growth_issuance_floor` (the latest share count could not be reconciled with the share history, so growth counts the last balance sheet plus only the filed issuances since — floors `historical` + `overall`) or `os_growth_rebased_partial` (growth measured on the company's own filed share history put onto one split basis, but some counts could not be placed — floors `historical` + `overall`) or `overhead_capacity_unquantified` (a live ATM, equity line or S-1 could not be converted to shares — size not stated or no current price — floors `overheadSupply` + `overall`). Name the stated reason, never another. `details.levelBounds` (since 2026-10-15) gives, per level, `floor` (the published level, unsized instruments counted at zero), `ceiling` (each unsized instrument at its filed maximum; null = some instrument has no filed maximum), `exact` (floor and ceiling agree, or the floor is high — the unsized instruments cannot move it, and the level is NOT in `levelsLowerBoundScope`), `bestEstimate` (each unsized instrument at its most likely size, never below the floor), `estimated` and `estimateBasis` (the assumptions, e.g. `atm_total_no_sales_reported`, `convertible_original_principal`). Signal8 surfaces show an estimated level as its `bestEstimate`; when you report one, say it is a best estimate and give the floor and ceiling — never present it as a measurement. `offeringAbilityBasis` / `overheadSupplyBasis` `atmRemainingBasis` / `elocRemainingBasis` say how a remaining was read: `total_minus_reported_sales` / `total_no_sales_reported` are the authorised total less reported sales, or the full total for a program started after the last periodic report — "up to". `details.osGrowthSource` names the share series behind `details.osGrowthRate`. When the rate is null, `details.osGrowthFacts` {fromShares, fromDate, toShares, toDate, splitsInWindow, basis} may carry two dated share counts from the filed history: a FACT, never a rating — the historical level stays not measured; with `basis: "as_filed"` the two counts are not on one split basis and must not be compared as growth. `levelsAreLowerBound` is always present. A null `overall` with a non-null `levelsWithheldReason` is WITHHELD — not low. `offeringAbility` is a capability profile, not pressure today: a live ATM/equity line whose drawable capacity is a MEASURED $0 (e.g. clamped by the I.B.6 cap) reads medium, while the score prices the $0 — do not describe that as the company being unable to raise. `overheadSupply` is TOTAL POTENTIAL DILUTION EXCLUDING SHELF as a % of shares outstanding: warrants, convertibles and preferred at their GROSS share counts, PLUS live ATM remaining (baby-shelf clamped) and equity-line remaining converted to shares at the current price, PLUS live S-1 registration shares, PLUS `details.registeredResaleOverhangShares` (already-issued affiliate shares on an EFFECTIVE resale registration). Low up to 20%, Medium 20-50%, High over 50%. Shelf capacity is NOT in it (that is `offeringAbility`). `details.overheadSupplyBasis` gives every component (`existingInstrumentShares`, `atmShares`, `elocShares`, `registeredShares`, `priceUsed`, `priceAsOf`, `pctOfOs`) and `unquantified` lists inputs that could not be converted; a null component is NOT MEASURED, never zero. It is NOT `inTheMoneySupplyPct` / `totalDilutiveShares`, which stay treasury-stock netted in-the-money figures. ALWAYS RETURNS 200 — read `available` and `reason`, never the HTTP status. Coverage is partial: `not_covered` means THIS COMPANY HAS NOT BEEN ANALYSED YET, which is different from it having no dilution and different from an outage (an outage is a 5xx). Never report a company as having no dilution on the strength of an unavailable response. NULL, absent or withheld means NOT MEASURED — it NEVER means "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a MEASURED zero and defeats a null check, so decide from the accompanying availability/withheld/reason field, never from the value itself. If a figure is absent, say it was not measured; do not describe the company as having none of that instrument. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` — a stale as-of date means the answer predates anything filed since, not that nothing has happened. Share counts are rebased onto a single split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted rather than published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro — without it the call returns 403 with code FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE and `requiredTier: "pro"`. That is a subscription-tier upgrade, not an add-on purchase; there is no separate add-on to buy.
